english: you put your foot in your mouth
also: if only you had kept quiet

terms.comment: Literally “oh, if you had kept quiet, you would have remained a philosopher”. We have found no ancient source for it in Lewis & Short or the loci collections.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, cited by printed page; each phrase checked against the searchable text of the book.
